description: Tests one function or class in isolation with fakes for collaborators. Fast; best for business rules.
Tests your code with real pieces wired together: the HTTP layer, middleware, a real database in a container.
Send requests to an app in memory without opening a port: Supertest for Express, `app.request()` and `testClient` for Hono, `inject()` for Fastify.
Library that starts real dependencies (Postgres, Redis) in Docker for a test run and disposes them afterwards.
Verifies that a provider API still satisfies what its consumers expect (Pact, OpenAPI schema checks).
A test that passes and fails without code changes, usually due to time, randomness, ordering or shared state.
